2511-3240-6277-6462.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Nether Traitor.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Nether Traitor triggers, causing you to pay {B} to return Nether Traitor from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Kheru Goldkeeper and On Wings of Gold triggers, creating a Treasure token and a creature token
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

240-5470-7272-8296.notablePrerequisites: You have at least four card types in your graveyard.
240-5470-7272-8296.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Reaper of Flight Moonsilver by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Reaper of Flight Moonsilver ability, giving Reaper of Flight Moonsilver +2/+1 until end of turn
Repeat from step 2.

1283-1651-4365-6753-8276.description:
Activate Chromatic Orrery by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}{C}.
Activate The Hive by paying {5} and tapping it, creating four 1/1 Wasp artifact creature tokens due to Mondrak and Exalted Sunborn.
Activate Clock of Omens twice by tapping the Wasps, untapping Chromatic Orrery and The Hive.
Repeat.
1283-1651-4365-6753-8276.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may instead use Chromatic Orrery's second ability to draw infinite cards.

2023-3755-4770-5295.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying its mana cost.
Aragorn triggers, creating a 1/1 Human Soldier creature token.
When Whitemane Lion enters, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Whitemane Lion and the Human Soldier token by tapping them, adding {1}{W}.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

512-1129-5475.easyPrerequisites: Harabaz Druid and Forensic Researcher do not have summoning sickness.
512-1129-5475.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two Allies.
512-1129-5475.description:
Activate Harabaz Druid by tapping it, adding at least {W}{W}
Activate Forensic Researcher by tapping it, targeting Halo Fountain.
Holding priority, activate Halo Fountain by paying {W}{W}, tapping it, and untapping Forensic Researcher and Harabaz Druid, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Forensic Researcher ability, untapping Halo Fountain.
Repeat.
512-1129-5475.notes: Once you have drawn your library, you may instead forego activating Harabaz Druid's ability to activate Halo Fountain's first ability to create near-infinite 1/1 Citizen creature tokens.

856-3899-5776-7422.description:
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing a Food.
Ygra triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar ability, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Cauldron Familiar and Garrison Excavator trigger.
Resolve the Garrison Excavator trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
When Cauldron Familiar dies, Ygra triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability.
Repeat.

1981-2415-4247-6720.easyPrerequisites:
You control another creature.
You have 2 or more life.
1981-2415-4247-6720.description:
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing a creature.
When the creature dies, Havoc Jester triggers, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Case of the Uneaten Feast triggers, causing you to gain life
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability.
Repeat.

141-7431.easyPrerequisites: There are legal target(s) for Daydream.
141-7431.description:
Cast Daydream by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, copying Daydream, with the copy targeting Naru Meha.
Resolve the copy of Daydream, blinking Naru Meha.
Repeat from step 3.

141-5188-5256.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in your graveyard.
141-5188-5256.description:
Cast Dread Return by paying its mana cost
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, targeting Dread Return.
Holding priority, activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Naru Meha.
Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, copying Dread Return
Resolve the Dread Return copy, returning Naru Meha from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

240-2034-4742-5470.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing an Egg token, adding {C}{C}
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

1329-2829-7340.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature that can tap to produce at least {U}.
1329-2829-7340.description:
Activate Emry by tapping it, allowing you to cast Sewer-veillance Cam from your graveyard this turn.
Activate a creature by tapping it, adding at least {U}.
Cast Sewer-veillance Cam from your graveyard by paying {U}.
When Sewer-veillance Cam enters, it triggers, untapping Emry.
Activate Arcbound Ravager by sacrificing Sewer-veillance Cam.
Sewer-veillance Cam triggers, untapping the mana-producing creature.
Resolve the Arcbound Ravager ability.
Repeat.

3967-4311-4871-5220.notablePrerequisites: You control a nontoken creature that can be cast using one colored mana.
3967-4311-4871-5220.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing the nontoken creature.
When the creature dies, Mortuary and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting the creature from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Cast the creature from the top of your library by paying its mana cost
Repeat.

1090-3817-3967.description:
Cast Restoration Angel by paying its mana cost.
When Restoration Angel enters the battlefield, it triggers, targeting Sister Hospitaller
Holding priority, activate Yahenni by sacrificing Restoration Angel.
Resolve the Restoration Angel ability, blinking Sister Hospitaller
When Sister Hospitaller enters, it triggers, returning Restoration Angel from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to gain 4 life.
Repeat from step 2.

1651-3875-5334-6756-6850.easyPrerequisites: You control a land that enters the battlefield untapped and that can tap to produce at least {1}.
1651-3875-5334-6756-6850.notablePrerequisites: Hearthhull has two or more charge counters on it.
1651-3875-5334-6756-6850.description:
Activate a land by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Activate Hearthhull by paying {1}, tapping it and sacrificing a land.
If Hearthhull has eight or more charge counters on it, it triggers, causing each opponent to lose 2 life.
Resolve the Hearthhull ability, causing you to draw two cards and allowing you to play an additional land this turn.
Play the land from your graveyard.
When the land enters the battlefield, Tireless Provisioner triggers twice due to Roaming Throne, creating two artifact tokens.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping the artifact tokens, untapping Hearthhull.
Repeat.

1170-1251-1329-3518.description:
Activate Emry by tapping it, allowing you to cast Lion's Eye Diamond from your graveyard.
Cast Lion's Eye Diamond by paying {0}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Emry.
When Emry enters, it triggers, causing you to mill four cards.
Activate Lion's Eye Diamond by discarding your hand and sacrificing it.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and with a +1/+1 counter on it

527-1978-5517.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {3}{G}.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Selvala.
Repeat

5220-5231-5447.easyPrerequisites: You control another nontoken creature that can be cast using {R} or less.
5220-5231-5447.notablePrerequisites: You have solved Case of the Locked Hothouse.
5220-5231-5447.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing the nontoken creature, adding {R}.
When the creature dies, Mortuary triggers, putting the creature from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Cast the creature by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

1456-1987-3980-4423.description:
Activate Mystic Sanctuary and Sisay's Ring by tapping them, adding {C}{C}{U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker either from your hand or from the top of your library by paying {2}{U}, blinking Mystic Sanctuary and Sisay's Ring.
When Mystic Sanctuary enters untapped, it triggers, putting Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Repeat.

1308-3951-4192-5703.easyPrerequisites: An opponent cannot block and kill Altaïr
1308-3951-4192-5703.description:
Declare Altaïr as an attacker, triggering its ability, exiling Éomer from your graveyard with a memory counter on it and creating two tapped and attacking copies of Éomer.
Put all but one Éomer token into your graveyard due to the legend rule, causing you to get at least one Éomer trigger, causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
At the end of your combat phase, Altaïr triggers, causing you to exile the Éomer token.
Repeat each combat phase.

710-1258-3967.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Danitha.
When Danitha dies, Abduction triggers, returning Danitha from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Danitha enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Abduction from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Danitha.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat.

1537-5470.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to create a token copy of Zealous Conscripts.
1537-5470.description:
Create a token copy of Zealous Conscripts.
Activate Ghired by tapping it, creating a token copy of the Zealous Conscripts copy.
When the Zealous Conscripts token enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping Ghired.
Repeat from step 2.

1003-3967-5220-5683.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Phyrexian Walker.
When Phyrexian Walker dies, Mortuary and Remembrance trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Phyrexian Walker from your graveyard on top of your library.
Resolve the Remembrance trigger, searching your library for Phyrexian Walker and putting it into your hand.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Cast Phyrexian Walker by paying {0}.
Repeat.

uses.n: Ojer Taq, Deepest Foundation // Temple of Civilization

1270-2757-5685.description:
Activate a basic Forest by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Propagator Drone by paying {3}{G}, creating three 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature tokens.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping an Eldrazi Spawn, untapping a basic Forest.
Activate the basic Forest by tapping it, adding {G}.
Repeat from step 3 two additional times.
Activate an Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Repeat.
1270-2757-5685.notes: Instead of tapping three Eldrazi Spawns, you can tap two and sacrifice two to gain infinite untapped creature tokens.

1433-2470-2645.notablePrerequisites: Mightstone's Animation attached to Staff of Domination.
1433-2470-2645.description:
Activate Grand Architect's first ability by paying {U}, causing Staff of Domination to become blue until end of turn.
Activate Grand Architect's second ability by tapping Staff of Domination, adding {C}{C} that can only be spent to cast artifact spells or to activate abilities of artifacts.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat from step 2.
Once you have infinite mana, you may instead tap Staff of Domination using its other abilities if it does not have summoning sickness.

2560-3059-4847.description:
Cast Chandra's Ignition by paying {3}{R}{R}, causing Malignus to deal damage equal to twice its power to each other creature and each opponent.
Each opponent loses the game due to having zero or less life.
